title: DevX Hands-on Playbook: Orchestrating SDK Labs, Docs Sprints, and Quickstart Templates
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a reproducible playbook and delivery pipeline for developer experience initiatives focused on hands-on SDK labs, docs sprint outputs, and quickstart template generation. The playbook must cover planning (learning objectives, target personas), content cadence (sprint templates for docs and code samples), tooling (repo templates, CI checks, preview environments), metrics and OKR alignment, and a rollout plan for pilot cohorts. This ticket scopes the first-playbook draft, a two-week pilot with internal developer advocates, and templates for three language SDKs (JS, Python, Java).
acceptance_criteria: 1) Playbook doc (Confluence) with step-by-step runbook and checklist for running a 2-week SDK lab and a docs sprint. 2) Repo templates for SDK labs and quickstarts created under github.com/redwood-inference/devx-templates. 3) CI preview configured so PRs create ephemeral docs previews. 4) Pilot run completed with 3 internal teams and feedback captured. 5) Success metrics and an OKR mapping table included in the playbook.
success_metrics:
- Pilot satisfaction >= 4/5 from 3 pilot teams
- 3 quickstart templates created and used in pilot
- Time-to-first-run for new contributors reduced from 45m to <=20m (measured by telemetry)
- Adoption signal: 10 unique projects reference template within 6 weeks
deliverables: Confluence playbook (playbook/devx-hands-on-playbook), github repo templates (devx-templates/{js,python,java}), CI preview workflow, pilot retrospective notes, OKR mapping spreadsheet (Drive link)
